structured.answer: I'd go with what the page marks as the cheapest pick: open a Pesagot account and buy the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 (4D) tracker fund. That gives about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years on 70,000 ₪ deposited (10,000 now plus 500 a month). Leumi is second at about 3,000 ₪ less.
